task.instruction: Plan the measuring route. Treat the supplied records as the complete synthetic evidence set and make one selection for each declared decision.
task.deliverable: A route plan with breadth or depth rationale, stop condition, and citations. Cite the named evidence references and do not list mutually incompatible selections.

evidence.content: The coverage card says all bars lack recent notes, while the notch log records an unexplained profile change.
A synthetic riverbed transect has six shallow bars and one deep channel notch; a single measuring rod can be carried along one route.
This synthetic plan record for case-research-a30 is bounded to the named observation and constraint. A valid conclusion must distinguish them, cite both, and avoid an unstated factual claim.

A.content: When coverage is the limiting need, represent the important range of cases before adding detail to any one case.

B.content: When understanding is the limiting need, examine the pivotal case deeply before extending coverage.

irrelevant.content: Use consistent spacing between sections in the final artifact.
